title: WorkItemAnswerRequest
description: POST /v1/work-items/{itemId}/answer: a person answers the item's question (work-items.md §7). The question is cleared and the text becomes the next round's input, as the requester's; the item is then driven on. 409 work_item_not_asking when the item asks nothing now: it ended, its question was answered already, or it waits on an approval, which is resolved through /v1/policy/approvals/{approvalId}/resolve and not answered.
